fusions.name: From a Dead Stop
fusions.desc: Holds still for 1.2 seconds, then launches your ride into the first enemy in its path. It deals 30 damage and always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Tail Skid
fusions.desc: Fishtails the back of your ride. It deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Idle in the Sun
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Sun-Warmed Engine
fusions.desc: By day, your damage rises by 12%.
